name: Estrategia de Seguridad Nacional 2021 (Real Decreto 1150/2021)
description: Estrategia de Seguridad Nacional 2021 (Real Decreto 1150/2021 of December 28, 2021, BOE-A-2021-21884). Overarching Spanish national security strategy approved by Royal Decree on the proposal of the President of the Government and the National Security Council under Law 36/2015 on National Security.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Departamento de Seguridad Nacional (dsn.gob.es) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Departamento de Seguridad Nacional (dsn.gob.es).

license.note: Official national strategy publication (dsn.gob.es); publicly released for free download, policy reference, and research.
